authority: ADR-0008 §5 DD-03 (adopts only values already documented; undocumented behaviour stays open)
Rendering §4.1 (linked-transform candidates; exact toggle/default remains a UX proposal)
DC-MP-CMP1 (fixed reuse/fairness protocol) and DC-MP-IMG5 (bounded preview/unavailable honesty)

classes.B: concrete documented default approved by ADR-0008

questions.question: Does selecting a second candidate enter Compare?
questions.decision: yes: first fills side A, second fills side B and switches to Compare

questions.question: Zero/one candidate behaviour
questions.decision: zero gives an empty dock/surface; one allows viewing while Compare states why it is unavailable
questions.open_condition: the native zero/one-candidate run remains NOT_REPRODUCIBLE with the current fixture

questions.question: Pair creation semantics
questions.decision: A then B forms the pair; a plain later selection moves Viewed only; a change-side action updates that side without moving Viewed; sides are never silently replaced; a repeated A or identical pair is refused
questions.source: ADR-0010 D-3 plus the DOCK2 duplicate-identity repair

questions.question: Linked-transform model (relative-to-fit vs physical 1:1) and default
questions.source: Rendering §4.1 presents both as candidates and says the exact toggle/default remains a UX proposal; ADR-0008 approves only documented values
questions.open_condition: Product/UX owner must choose the model and its default before CMP1/IMG5 linked presentation

questions.question: Fit/1:1 switching
questions.source: no documented default or toggle semantics

questions.question: Cursor-anchor mapping and per-pane clamping
questions.decision: each pane clamps independently against its own bounds; a clamped pane's anchor is never fed back into the link; these invariants hold for either candidate model
questions.open_condition: the shared-anchor mapping formula depends on the Q5 model choice and stays open with Q5; no candidate-specific formula is approved here

questions.question: Link/unlink transitions and what unlink restores
questions.decision: link/unlink preserves the viewed pair and local focus and never changes formal selection; independent mode keeps each pane's own transform
questions.open_condition: the exact transform restored after unlink (relative framing vs previous pane state) is E until Q5

questions.question: "Restore previous view" definition
questions.decision: closing Compare returns to the Artifact surface with the current Viewed candidate and that candidate's own view framing; Compare-session pane transforms are discarded and no other history is replayed
questions.open_condition: D-7 covers close/restore-to-viewed. A separate 'restore previous view' command beyond D-7 is not defined and is not invented here.

questions.question: Keyboard/focus transfer into/out of panes and across swap/removal
questions.decision: keyboard focus must be preserved deliberately and must not change selection (dock/focus principles)
questions.open_condition: the exact pane-entry/transfer order is E

questions.question: Unavailable-artifact presentation per representation
questions.decision: a bounded supported preview or an explicit unavailable state; preview never claims full detail/1:1
questions.open_condition: the exact per-representation copy/visual is E

questions.question: Same-key resource reuse visibility
questions.decision: same-key panes may share one decode/upload entry; the adoption rule is fixed and the miss must be reported
questions.open_condition: whether/how reuse is surfaced to the user is E; measurement is F

measurement: Q7/Q8/Q13/Q14 remain unmeasured until CMP1/IMG5 experiments
boundary: This register records classifications only. It adds no UX value, no API and no product behaviour; every E item and every additional open detail blocks only its own behaviour.
additional_open_details: Q8 unlink restore detail follows Q5
